name: browser-workflow-tools
description: Production-grade browser userscripts for developer productivity, LLM context packing, archive lookups, and web privacy.
author: Shivansh Jain <https://github.com/shivanshjain456>

scripts.check:syntax: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['clip-leetcode/clip-leetcode.user.js','codebase-uploader/codebase-uploader.user.js','chatgpt-conversation-bridge/chatgpt-conversation-bridge.user.js','web-archives/web-archives.user.js','youtube-search-command/youtube-search-command.user.js','yt-share-antitrack/yt-share-antitrack.user.js','save-image-as-type/save-image-as-type.user.js'].forEach(f => new Function(fs.readFileSync('scripts/' + f, 'utf8'))); console.log('All 7 userscripts are valid JavaScript syntax.');"
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:meta && npm run check:perm && npm run check:secrets
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test
